description: This file defines Flutter widgets for skeleton loading placeholders called Skeleton and CircleSkeleton, used to show placeholder UI elements during content loading.

classes.name: Skeleton
classes.description: A widget displaying a rectangular skeleton placeholder with configurable size, layers, and border radius.

classes.name: CircleSkeleton
classes.description: A widget displaying a circular skeleton placeholder with configurable size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for Skeleton and CircleSkeleton widgets.
